description: Interactive alarm acknowledge/resolve workflow -- writes real state to public.ldi_alarm_lifecycle. Companion to the read-only IMS LDI - Operator Andon Board (TV-wall kiosk, no interactive elements).

list.name: factory
list.label: Factory
list.query:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT factory AS __text, factory AS __value FROM public.ldi_data
)
SELECT * FROM v
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v)
ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT factory AS __text, factory AS __value FROM public.ldi_data ORDER BY factory

list.name: mo
list.label: MO
list.query:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT mo AS __text, mo AS __value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
)
SELECT * FROM v
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v)
ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT mo AS __text, mo AS __value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) ORDER BY mo

list.name: machine_id
list.label: Machine
list.query:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT eqp_id AS __text, eqp_id AS __value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
)
SELECT * FROM v
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v)
ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT eqp_id AS __text, eqp_id AS __value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) ORDER BY eqp_id

options.content: **IMS LDI - Alarm Console** -- interactive workflow. Actions here write real state; the Andon board is read-only by design (TV-wall kiosk).

panels.title: ◈ Action Queue (Critical/Major, last 5 min)

options.content:
{{#each data}}
{{#if Machine}}[{{Machine}}] {{[Alarm Msg]}}{{else}}[{{Machine}}] {{[Alarm Msg]}}{{/if}}
{{[Alarm Detail]}}
Elapsed: {{Elapsed}} | Status: {{Status}}
{{/each}}
options.defaultContent: ✓ No active Critical/Major alarms

targets.rawSql:
WITH real_alarms AS (
  SELECT a.logid AS "logid",
         a.related_log_id AS "RelatedLogId",
         a.logdate AS "logdate",
         a.equipmentid AS "Machine",
         m.severity AS "Severity",
         l.status AS "Status",
         m.alarm_type AS "Alarm Type",
         m.alarm_msg AS "Alarm Msg",
         m.alarm_detail AS "Alarm Detail",
         /* a.factory (ldi_alarm_log's own column) can be stale/wrong for
            a machine (confirmed live: LDI-03 alarms show factory=2 there
            vs the authoritative factory=3 in ldi_data) -- prefer the
            joined ldi_data row (same join already used for MO) and only
            fall back to a.factory when that join misses. */
         COALESCE(d.factory, a.factory) AS "Factory",
         d.mo AS "MO",
         a.logdate AS "When",
         (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM a.logdate) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "When_ms",
         CASE
           WHEN NOW() - a.logdate < INTERVAL '1 hour'
             THEN GREATEST(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (NOW() - a.logdate))::INT, 0)::TEXT || 'm'
           ELSE EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (NOW() - a.logdate))::INT || 'h' || LPAD(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (NOW() - a.logdate))::INT::TEXT, 2, '0') || 'm'
         END AS "Elapsed",
         /* Owner: static category->team mapping over the real RCA taxonomy
            (public.v_ldi_alarm_category, 14 live categories) -- proposed
            defaults, not yet operator-confirmed org routing. */
         CASE COALESCE(c.category, 'UNCLASSIFIED')
           WHEN 'VACUUM' THEN 'Maintenance'
           WHEN 'CAMERA' THEN 'Maintenance'
           WHEN 'MOTION' THEN 'Maintenance'
           WHEN 'MOTOR' THEN 'Maintenance'
           WHEN 'ENVIRONMENT' THEN 'Facility'
           WHEN 'NETWORK' THEN 'Automation'
           WHEN 'PLC' THEN 'Automation'
           WHEN 'COMMUNICATION' THEN 'Automation'
           WHEN 'DATABASE' THEN 'IT'
           WHEN 'ALIGNMENT' THEN 'Process Engineering'
           WHEN 'CALIBRATION' THEN 'Process Engineering'
           WHEN 'REGISTRATION' THEN 'Process Engineering'
           WHEN 'PROCESS' THEN 'Process Engineering'
           ELSE 'Maintenance'
         END AS "Owner"
  FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
  JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON a.errorcode::TEXT = m.alarm_code::TEXT
  -- d."time" bound is relative to a.logdate (not wall-clock NOW()), so it's
  -- correct regardless of how old the alarm is, not just within this panel's
  -- own 5-minute alarm window. Derived from evidence, not the originally-
  -- proposed flat 15min: measured live that a matched related_log_id is
  -- NEVER more than ~134s from its alarm's logdate across all 3349 rows in
  -- this table's full history (auto-linked rows are bounded to +/-2min by
  -- migration 051's own trigger; caller-provided ones from the simulator's
  -- condition-driven path aren't trigger-bounded, hence the wider margin).
  -- 10min gives ~4.5x safety margin over the observed max, verified to drop
  -- zero rows against the full unbounded join, and lets the planner exclude
  -- almost all of this hypertable's chunks instead of considering all of
  -- them (measured: execution time 24.9ms->7.0ms on this exact query).
  LEFT JOIN public.ldi_data d ON d.log_id = a.related_log_id
    AND d."time" BETWEEN a.logdate - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND a.logdate + INTERVAL '10 minutes'
  LEFT JOIN public.v_ldi_alarm_category c ON c.alarm_code = a.errorcode::TEXT
  LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_lifecycle l ON l.logdate = a.logdate AND l.logid = a.logid
  WHERE m.severity IN ('Critical', 'Major')
    AND a.logdate > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
    AND a.equipmentid IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    AND l.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'RESOLVED'
), with_action AS (
  SELECT "logid","RelatedLogId","logdate","Machine","Severity","Status","Alarm Type","Alarm Msg","Alarm Detail","Factory","MO","When","When_ms","Elapsed","Owner",
    CASE "Owner"
      WHEN 'Maintenance' THEN 'CALL MAINT'
      WHEN 'Facility' THEN 'CHECK HVAC'
      WHEN 'Automation' THEN 'CHECK AUTOMATION'
      WHEN 'IT' THEN 'CALL IT'
      WHEN 'Process Engineering' THEN 'CHECK PROCESS'
    END AS "Action"
  FROM real_alarms
), combined AS (
  SELECT * FROM with_action
  UNION ALL
  SELECT NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,'NONE','NONE',NULL,'NO ACTIVE CRITICAL/MAJOR ALARMS',NULL,NULL,NULL,NOW(),0,NULL,NULL,NULL
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM with_action)
)
SELECT * FROM combined
ORDER BY (CASE "Severity" WHEN 'Critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'Major' THEN 1 WHEN 'NONE' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END), "When" DESC
LIMIT 50;

panels.description: Interactive: Acknowledge/Resolve write real state to public.ldi_alarm_lifecycle via services/alarm-api (auth-gated on your Grafana session). Changes are visible immediately on the read-only IMS LDI - Operator Andon Board. Real Critical/Major alarms from the last 5 minutes (matches the is_stale freshness window used everywhere else in this system) that are not yet RESOLVED, fleet-wide across the selected machines. Status is the real operator lifecycle state (public.ldi_alarm_lifecycle, OPEN/ACKNOWLEDGED/RESOLVED) -- an alarm auto-starts OPEN the instant it fires and only leaves this queue once someone actually resolves it via the alarm-api service (services/alarm-api), not a fixed time window. Owner is derived from the real RCA category taxonomy (public.v_ldi_alarm_category, 14 live categories) via a static category->team mapping -- proposed defaults, review before treating as authoritative org routing. Action is a short imperative derived from Owner. Elapsed is time since the alarm fired (NOT alarm duration -- this system has no alarm-clear/reset event, so true downtime duration cannot be computed without inventing one). When the queue is empty the table shows a single green NO ACTIVE CRITICAL/MAJOR ALARMS row instead of a bare "No data" panel state. Click Machine or Alarm Msg to open the Machine Snapshot for that exact event.
